verdict.rationale: Fellow's Developer API exposes action items (get/mark complete/archive) and webhooks fire on events like action-item completion, giving an agent the raw building blocks to sync items into an external tracker via custom integration [fellow-docs-5][fellow-docs-43][fellow-docs-46]. However, there is no evidence of a native, pre-built integration or automation specifically for Linear, Jira, or Asana — this would require custom glue code rather than a documented connector. Missing for 10: documented native Linear/Jira/Asana integration or automation template, and any example/community confirmation of this exact workflow.
